subject: SummitGroup expansion: add apps + rollout plan
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitgroup.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-08T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Expansion request — 3 teams / 4 new apps

Hi Dylan,

We're ready to move forward with expanding Redwood across three additional product teams at SummitGroup. Current ask: provision dedicated API keys for four new internal apps (mobile-auth, search-svc, billing-insights, analytics-batch), a rough idea of expected steady-state RPS per app (see attached spreadsheet), and an initial rollout window before end of Q1.

Can you share:
- High-level cost estimate (tokens/day estimate included in spreadsheet)
- Whether we can segment keys by project and enforce per-key throttle limits
- Preferred timeline and any prerequisites from our side (contracts, PO, network allowlist)

Happy to set up a 30-min call next week. Looping in procurement separately.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Director of AI Platforms
SummitGroup
Attachment: summit_expansion_requirements.xlsx
From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitgroup.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 teams / 4 new apps

Hi Aisha — thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. We can absolutely support segmented API keys and per-key throttles; we'll also set up RBAC so your teams only see their own keys in the console.

Quick answers:
- Cost: ballpark estimate attached (per-app estimate + burst capacity). Final pricing depends on token profile after we validate sample traces.
- Segmentation: yes — keys per app + configurable quotas and alerting.
- Timeline: proposed kickoff week of 2026-11-29 with staging for 2 weeks and production ramp through end of Q1.

Next steps I propose:
1) 30-min technical kickoff (monica will lead) to validate traffic patterns and throttles
2) Procurement intake (Aisha — please share your PO process contact)
3) We prepare a mutual action plan and a Docusign for the scope amendment (I attached a proposed quote).

I'll schedule the kickoff once we confirm availability.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_proposed_quote_SG-2026-114.pdf
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitgroup.com>, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-10T11:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — MAP & kickoff prep

Aisha / team — example mutual action plan below (we'll refine on the call):

1) Before kickoff (by 2026-11-25)
   - SummitGroup: share sample traces for each new app (5–10 representative requests) and confirm network allowlist IPs
   - Redwood: provide detailed per-app cost model and per-key quota recommendations

2) Technical kickoff (30–45 min) — week of 2026-11-29
   - Attendees: Monica (solutions), Logan (SRE), Aisha, 1x product owner per app
   - Agenda: traffic profile, auth flows, KV/cache expectations, rollout gating

3) Staging (2 weeks)
   - Redwood provisions staging keys and a dedicated dev pool; we run soak tests and check latency targets

4) Production ramp (phased across Mar-May)
   - Controlled ramp per app with rollback windows and automated throttling

If procurement needs a contract amendment template let me know — otherwise we'll send the scope addendum for signature after kickoff.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: procurement@summitgroup.com
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitgroup.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — SummitGroup procurement intake

Hi Marissa / Dylan,

Thanks — procurement here. Our standard intake: we need a single amendment/statement of work reflecting new apps, expected annual spend estimate, and a single PO to cover the first 12 months. Our preferred payment terms are Net 60. I've attached our procurement template with required vendor fields.

Two questions up front:
- Can Redwood accept consolidated invoicing for the account (one invoice, itemized by app)?
- Are there any changes to data residency or retention for these additional keys?

Attachment: procurement_terms_SummitGroup.pdf

Regards,
SummitGroup Procurement Team
From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitgroup.com>, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-16T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — technical notes & staging plan

Hi all — technical notes to support the kickoff:

- Keying + quotas: we'll create 4 project-level keys and a separate staging key per app. Each key can have per-minute and per-day quotas; recommend starting with conservative per-minute limits for the mobile-auth app due to spikey traffic.
- Caching: mobile-auth and search-svc will benefit from prefix/KV caching; provide your cache-hit expectations so we can size the dev pool.
- Dedicated dev pool: we'll provision a small dedicated dev pool that mirrors your production instance (same model family, lower capacity) for soak tests.
- Observability: we'll enable per-key telemetry and set up alerting thresholds for token burn and latency.

Draft staging schedule (adjustable):
- Day 0: provision keys and allowlist
- Day 1–3: smoke tests (auth flows, quotas)
- Day 4–10: soak testing with synthetic load + production shadowing for one app
- Day 11–14: readiness review and sign-off

Attachment: staging-config.yaml (contains sample quota blocks and allowlist fields)

If this looks good we'll put these bullets into the kickoff agenda and lock a time.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@summitgroup.com>, procurement@summitgroup.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — kickoff scheduled and next steps

Aisha / Procurement — quick update and confirmation:

- Kickoff scheduled: 2026-11-30 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent). Monica will run the technical portion; Marissa will run MAP and procurement intake.
- We can accept consolidated invoicing and Net 60; finance will include that language in the amendment.
- No data residency changes required for these apps — they inherit the account-level retention controls (confirmed by infra).
- I've uploaded the proposed amendment to DocuSign (link below) so procurement can review and we'll route for signature after kickoff.

Action items before kickoff:
- SummitGroup: upload sample traces + allowlist by 2026-11-25 (Aisha)
- Redwood: finalize per-app estimates and staging keys (we'll share updated quote by 2026-11-26)

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/SG-2026-114 | https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC-7890

Thanks everyone — talk soon.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
